name: jfa-go
description: jfa-go is a user management app for Jellyfin (and Emby as 2nd class) that provides invite-based account creation as well as other features that make one's instance much easier to manage.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-jfa-go application
services:
  # Main service configuration for the JFA-GO application
  # This service provides a web interface running on port 8056 for user administration
  big-bear-jfa-go:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-jfa-go
    # Image to be used for the container specifies the hrfee/jfa-go version and source
    image: hrfee/jfa-go:latest@sha256:701cfca823f9278b65f4cf7706b0c7f89b3be33e17ca077f11d89dc119e9f307
    # Container restart policy - restarts the container unless manually stopped
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volume mappings required for system integration
    # These mounts allow the container to interact with the host system
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/.config/jfa-go:/data # Path to wherever you want to store the config file and other data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/jellyfin:/jf # Only needed for password resets through Jellyfin, ignore if not using or using Emby
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro # Makes sure time is correct
    # Map port 8056 on the host to port 8056 on the container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8056"
